fix(persistence): validate checkpoint record shapes and metadata

Reject malformed city/outside records and metadata that disagrees with the city before returning a reconstructed session, so invalid records identify their exact source. Validate historical society shapes without changing their data or the existing refusal to play old rulesets.

Strengthen all nine current fixtures with explicit serializer success and preserve exact record round-trip plus refusal assertions for all 27 historical fixtures, as clarified by the owner.

fix(ui): retry temporarily unavailable legacy storage

Keep unavailable legacy storage distinct from an absent checkpoint, leaving migration unmarked until the read can complete. Resolve browser localStorage lazily on each use so a temporarily blocked getter can recover without replacing the cached GameStore.

fix(ui): discard stale checkpoint action completions

Capture the live revision and checkpoint/import tickets before Continue or Main menu waits on storage. Drop superseded results without replacing newer state or feedback, and keep Main menu in the session when a Planning command happened during its save.

fix(ui): serialize checkpoint operations in invocation order

Keep a pending save ahead of the fallen clear that follows it so a late write cannot resurrect that checkpoint. Queue reads, saves and clears through one module-level chain, recover the chain after rejection, and capture each save before it waits.
